data.name: Pogo Together
data.detailed_description:
One pogo stick. One ridiculously jacked animal. Absolutely no dignity.

Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based climbing game where you and your friends take control of absurdly muscular animals and attempt to bounce your way to the top.

SUFFER TOGETHER

Bring your friends along and try to make it to the top together.

Work together through difficult sections and climb as a group (or kick someone off a platform and send their progress down with them).

Play nice or make things worse. It’s up to you.

Prefer to suffer in peace? You can play solo too.

MASTER THE POGO

Learn a physics-driven movement system where balance, timing, momentum, and control determine whether you stick the landing or go flying back down.

The controls are simple. Getting good at them is another story.

MEET THE CREW

Choose from a cast of bizarre, suspiciously jacked animals, each equally unqualified to operate a pogo stick.

Unlock new characters as you play and find your favorite way to look ridiculous while falling from extreme heights.

ONE MISTAKE CAN COST EVERYTHING

Climb through increasingly dangerous environments filled with tiny platforms, moving obstacles, traps, shortcuts, and jumps that looked much easier from below.

There are no stairs. There is only pogo.

data.short_description: Bounce, fall, rage, and climb together. Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based precision platformer where ridiculously jacked animals attempt to conquer brutal obstacles on pogo sticks. Help each other, kick each other off, or take on the climb alone.

content_descriptors.notes: Pogo Together is a challenging, physics-based pogo stick platforming game featuring a main cast of muscular animal guys. The characters can be dismembered when they fall from high platforms or get caught in various piercing and crushing obstacles.
